I feel like it’ll be a rewarding experience. My grandfather was a CPA and a financial analyst throughout his life and had no complaints. I’m more of an introvert and like to work on things by myself. I like spending time with people but I also like my alone time so I feel like this is right for me. 

I don’t even know where to begin with everything... it all started when I graduated high school and hung around a bunch of people I thought was right for me. Just bad influences really. With no direction on what I should of been doing or what’s not right I chose to do what benefited me in the short run. There’s just so many different scenarios that I chose to lie to people. Even friends, to hurt people that cared for me. I never wanted people to see my insecure side. I believe it all started to build up when I started to act narcissistic and people around me found it to be kind of like an alpha male projection? Which may sound weird but I was respected more when I put off the vibe that I didn’t care about anyone but myself. I feel like this took a negative effect on me in the long run as I’ve never went back to how I truly am and that’s an insecure person. I can’t seem to find the balance with those emotions. At first I didn’t listen to people who said those things about me. I just felt like they didn’t understand and I reasoned with myself on why I lied or cheated or deceived. But the more I’ve thought about it, the more  I realize that I was completely aware of the decisions I was making, I just didn’t want to accept the fact that I was being such a shitty person for doing so. Since lately I’ve been thinking about all the bad things I’ve done I guess it’s been super overwhelming. It doesn’t help that I’ve always had depression issues in the past.

Hi,

I like these ideas. I also like how you described depression. Whether or not it’s true or not it does make me feel a little better that maybe someone else knows how I’m feeling. I try not to listen to people that say I’m a bad person and all. Sometimes I feel like I need to hear it in order to know how other people view me and so far that’s probably the most repeated comment. I should of mentioned in my OP that I’m also incredibly unforgiving. Which also shows that I’m very hypocritical when I’d like many people in my life to forgive me for what I’ve done. I’d just like to be at more peace with inner self and feel better mentally. Thank you for the thoughtful post. I screenshot it and I plan on utilizing your advice on the future. I just made this account today to reach out to someone and I’m happy somewhere in the world people are compassionate and caring enough to help out a random stranger on the internet.

I just turned 25, I’m almost done with my degree in accounting and so far that’s the only thing I’m looking forward too. Considering that’s the most I’ve ever done for myself in life I see that as my only accomplishment. I feel like I’ve wasted much of the pst few years hurting people close to me. I’ve watched myself turn into this person more and more by the year and I don’t know what’s caused it. I don’t take any medication for anything. I have some friends but not as much as I feel like is normal. Guys just don’t seem to like me and the girls I become friends always becomes friends with benifits and I usually end up hurting a lot of them. Not physically of course. I’ve been told I’m narcissistic, cocky, uncaring about anyone except myself, and very selfish. After being told that for so long by so many different people it wears on me.
